title: bidens artemisiifolia var. calva
intro: Bidens artemisiifolia var. calva, commonly known as American beggar-ticks, is a plant species native to North America. This plant is valued for its medicinal properties, particularly in traditional medicine, where it has been used to treat a variety of health issues. The health benefits of Bidens artemisiifolia var. calva include anti-inflammatory and antiseptic properties, making it effective in treating wounds, skin irritations, and infections. The bioactive constituents responsible for its therapeutic actions are triterpenes and flavonoids, which have been shown to exhibit antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and antimicrobial properties.
